Also just ran into this myself, its because of this line here [EntityRendererMixin.java#L42](https://github.com/bernie-g/geckolib/blob/main/common/src/main/java/software/bernie/geckolib/mixin/client/EntityRendererMixin.java#L42) casting to generic type `R` of  `GeoArmorRenderer#captureRenderStates` which is type erasured to `AvatarRenderState` not the `HumanoidRenderState` it checks in the instanceof above

Yeah this is caused by me fixing a previous alpha issue, which brought this issue to light

I'm revising how I want to do armour in general at the moment due to the internal MC changes
